title: One file system, a mount target in each zone
claim: Every instance reaches one shared file system through the mount target in its own Availability Zone.
alt: Two Availability Zones in one Region. In each zone, an instance connects to the EFS mount target of its own zone. Both mount targets lead to one Amazon EFS file system, which stores the data across the zones.

edges.label: mount
edges.say: Each instance mounts the file system by its Domain Name System (DNS) name.
The name resolves to the IP address of the EFS mount target in the same zone.

edges.label: NFS port
edges.say: The client connects to the NFS port (TCP port 2049) of that mount target.
The file system serves one to thousands of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) instances at the same time.

edges.label: stores data
edges.say: A Regional file system stores data across multiple geographically separated Availability Zones.
